plan: A charming support who leaps into the middle of enemies and charms them while dancing.
aSurveiller: His W (Grand Entrance). He leaps and knocks up everyone around: don't stay grouped.
contrer: Spread out when he leaps: his W knocks up those around.
His R charms as he passes: get out of his path.
Engage him once his E is used: it's his escape.

sorts.Q: Feather that then heals his allies.
sorts.E: Flies to an ally with a shield.
